source: K. Mackay (2025), Hauraki Gulf BathyTopo Digital Elevation Model, 20 m cells, Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.15887269, published 15 July 2025. A revised version of Mackay et al. (2012), Hauraki Gulf, NIWA Chart Miscellaneous Series 91. CC BY 4.0. Not to be used for navigation.
projection: EPSG:3994, WGS 84 / Mercator 41. Read from the file.
datum: Bathymetry: Lowest Astronomical Tide (LAT). Land heights: New Zealand Vertical Datum 2016, from LINZ LiDAR. The record does not say where the two sources meet. A check against the LINZ charts placed the grid's 0 m line on the charts' drying line, so every value is read as a height above LAT.
depth: Meters below chart datum. Chart datum is taken as LAT (latAboveCd).
drying: Heights at or above LAT are raised by 0.4 m, and heights within 0.5 m below LAT by a share of it, because the LINZ drying heights read higher than the grid.
reduced: Each cell keeps the shallowest of the 20 m cells whose centers fall inside it.
